description: Hand your step report over to the portal as the LAST action of a dispatched job, instead of posting the ticket comment yourself. The portal records the verdict on the step (the playbook gate reads it from there), writes the ticket comment from your report in the account's report shape — a readable comment, a short summary with the report attached as a numbered file, both, or nothing at all on the quiet shape — translates it when a report language is set, and edits the comment of an earlier call in the same step instead of posting again. Publish evidence with publish_artifact first and pass its links as evidence. Every failure is non-fatal: the result then tells you to post your ONE comment yourself.

body.description: The full report in Markdown — the sections your workflow asks for (what changed, how to verify, the handoff checklist, the findings). No closing verdict line: the portal adds it.

evidence.description: Links that evidence the report: the PR, the download links publish_artifact returned (at most 20).

filename.description: Optional name for the report file (Markdown); the portal numbers it on the ticket when it attaches it.

summary.description: One or two sentences: what the step did and where it stands (at most 2,000 characters).

verdict.description: The step verdict token, one of the workflow's verdicts (e.g. PR_OPEN, WORK_CONTINUE, BLOCKED, PASS, FAIL). Only the token — never a sentence.

name: publish_report
